title: An existing repository needs a live access check
need: Always check GitHub live. If absent, add owner/repo using the exact installation settings link and check again. Failed checks mean unknown access; no browser failure is claimed without an attempt. A nonempty private-repository picker also offers grant access and URL entry; check again refreshes the list after access changes. URL entry uses the connected credential and existing clone refusal recovery.
review: Scripted stale-cache, settings identity and failed-check cases; live deployment proof pending.
